guide.factorycore.page.0:
Factory Guide

Build a storage network step by step. No scripts or other mods are needed for storage, hoppers or presets.

Turn the page to start.
guide.factorycore.page.1:
1. First network

Craft a Network Controller (4 iron, 4 redstone, 1 glass) and place it. It belongs to you. Connect blocks with Network Cable; controllers and cables join on all six faces.
guide.factorycore.page.2:
2. Storage

Craft a Storage Drive and a Starter Item Cell. Use the cell on the drive to install it (4 cells per drive). Cable the drive to the controller. Use the controller to check its status.
guide.factorycore.page.3:
3. Terminal

Place a Storage Terminal on the network and use it. Search, take 1 or 64, Shift-click items to store them. The Fluids/Energy button switches views for buckets and FE items.
guide.factorycore.page.4:
4. Hopper to terminal

Place a Buffered Interface on the network and point a hopper into it. Crouch-use it with both hands empty to enable Import. Hopper items then appear in the terminal.
guide.factorycore.page.5:
5. Safe cell upgrades

Sneak-use the drive with an empty hand to remove a cell. Hold it in your offhand and use a module: Expansion, then Advanced, then Infinite. Contents are kept; failures cost nothing.
guide.factorycore.page.6:
6. Machines and presets

Put a Machine Interface against a machine, label it with renamed paper, then use it to set resource, access, priority and rate. Presets move items without any code.
guide.factorycore.page.7:
7. Power

Fuel Generators burn furnace fuel into FE. Energy Banks on the network store it. Programs, wireless blocks and links all run on FE.
guide.factorycore.page.8:
8. Crafting

Use the terminal grid to craft from storage and encode Blank Patterns. Put patterns in a Crafting Unit and request items in the Jobs view, or use Keep to hold stock.
guide.factorycore.page.9:
9. Processing

Processing Patterns go in a Crafting Interface facing a machine such as a furnace. Jobs send inputs and collect outputs automatically.
guide.factorycore.page.10:
10. Programs

A Program Controller runs simple rules such as keep 64 iron_ingot. Templates help you start. Advanced users can upload Wasm programs. It needs FE and Deploy rights.
guide.factorycore.page.11:
11. Branches

A Gateway's eye face is upstream and its red face is downstream. Sneak-use it to choose what the branch may do and see. Nested gateways only narrow access.
guide.factorycore.page.12:
12. Wireless

Power a Wireless Access Point, bind a Wireless Terminal to it and use the terminal within 64 blocks. Each action costs 64 FE from the handheld.
guide.factorycore.page.13:
13. Links

Place Wireless Link Endpoints against two gateways up to 256 blocks apart. Sneak-use one, then the other, to pair them. Each end needs its own FE.
